PowerShell($env:WATCOM = \(Resolve-Path .\\WATCOM\).Path; $env:INCLUDE = "$env:WATCOM\\h;$env:WATCOM\\h\\nt"; $env:PATH = "$env:WATCOM\\binnt;$env:PATH"; Remove-Item -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue launcher.obj, launcher.err, Minecraft9xLauncher.exe, Minecraft9xLauncher.map, Minecraft9xLauncher.sym, Minecraft9xLauncher.lk1; & wpp386.exe launcher.cpp -w4 -e25 -zq -od -d2 -6r -bt=nt -fo=.obj -mf -xs -xr 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 60)

PowerShell($p = "$env:APPDATA\\.minecraft\\assets"; if \(Test-Path $p\) { Get-ChildItem $p -Name; "--- indexes:"; Get-ChildItem "$p\\indexes" -Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { "no .minecraft/assets at $p" })
